people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed about them, and said to them, “You are spies! You have come to see the nakedness of the land.”
translations.bsb: Joseph remembered his dreams about them and said, “You are spies! You have come to see if our land is vulnerable.”
translations.kjv: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
translations.asv: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
